title: Nasa astronauts' moon mission delayed due to rocket issue
summary: The mission to the far side of the Moon and back will be postponed after problems with were spotted with its rocket, a Nasa official said.

title: Mississippi health system shuts down clinics statewide after ransomware attack
summary: The attack was launched on Thursday and prompted hospital officials to close all of its 35 clinics across the state.

title: Arturia’s FX Collection 6 adds two new effects and a $99 intro version
